binding_force.quote: The National Artificial Intelligence Policy for the Republic of Rwanda serves as a roadmap
binding_force.reason: The document calls itself a roadmap and policy, and it states no adoption by cabinet, parliament or another approving body; the only attribution is 'MINICT - 2022'.

responsible_body.quote: The RAI Office is to be given the mandate to implement the National AI Policy
responsible_body.reason: The Responsible AI Office within MINICT is named with stated duties (coordinating implementation, monitoring and evaluation, communications), and each implementation-plan activity names a lead institution, although the office is proposed for establishment in year one rather than already existing.

funding.quote: support the financing by building upon the Seed Investment Fund to co-invest alongside specialist funds
funding.reason: Funding sources are mentioned (Seed Investment Fund, public-sector funding, risk-sharing and co-investment funds), but no amount appears anywhere; page 9 says the full plan includes a budget, but this summary shows none.

measurable_targets.quote: Set Up a taskforce to research and identify a portfolio of 5 National AI Projects
measurable_targets.reason: There are some numbers (5 National AI Projects) and some deadlines (RAI Office in the first year), but no number is tied to a stated deadline; the FY column headers show no readable timing per activity, and all indicators are 'Number of...' with no target values, so the lower score applies.

jobs_workforce.quote: Commit to reskilling the workforce with 21st Century AI and data skills.
jobs_workforce.reason: Skills, upskilling and reskilling goals are extensive, but there are no plans for workers displaced by AI and no transition support or social protection; general employee reskilling is borderline, so the lower score applies.

risk_safety.quote: Initiate regulatory sandbox projects on Al to provide controlled testing environment
risk_safety.reason: Beyond general risk and ethics language, the document commits to regulatory sandbox projects that provide a controlled testing environment to evaluate AI solutions against the ethics guidelines, which is a specific testing measure.

data_protection.quote: cloud service providers under the supervisory authority (NCSA) as required by law (DPP)
data_protection.reason: The implementation plan links to a named data protection law (DPP) and names the supervisory authority (NCSA), including an activity to 'Enforce the Data Protection & Privacy law'.

enforcement.quote: By strengthening the capacity of regulatory authorities to understand and regulate AI
enforcement.reason: AI regulation is framed as future capacity-building and future sector-specific guidelines, with no AI penalties or sanctions; the compliance audits on page 14 apply only to cloud providers under existing law, so between 1 and 2 the lower score applies.

local_language.reason: I looked for mentions of Kinyarwanda, other local languages, local-language datasets or models, and adapting AI to local cultural context, and found none; references to 'local' concern solution providers and data value-chains, not language or context.

monitoring_evaluation.quote: the RAI Office or RAIO will be tasked with the monitor-ing and evaluation
monitoring_evaluation.reason: A reviewer (RAIO) and output indicators are named, but no schedule for reviewing the policy is given; the annual AI Readiness Index is a benchmark rather than a policy review, so the lower score applies.
